test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The price of an article is first increased by 20% and later on, it is decreased by 25% due to reduction in sales. Find the net percentage change in final price of the article.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net factor = 1.20 × 0.75 = 0.90

% change = (0.90 − 1) × 100 = −10%

**∴ Answer = 10% decrease**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Increase = 20%

Decrease = 25%

**Formula used:**

Successive percentage change ⇒ multiply factors

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let original price = 100

⇒ After increase ⇒ 100 × 1.20 = 120

⇒ After decrease ⇒ 120 × 0.75 = 90

⇒ Final price = 90

⇒ Change = 90 − 100 = −10

⇒ % change = −10%

**∴ The correct answer is 10% decrease.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Change

Multiply increase and decrease factors

Shortcut

Net % = a − b − (ab/100)

Concept

Final price depends on compound change
